title: TRAP: Tool-result Replay Attack for Probing Misbinding in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.16333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI agents increasingly act through external tools, tool results are no longer simple outputs but execution artifacts that must remain correctly associated with the context that produced them. Yet as results persist across caches, recovery mechanisms, and shared runtime state, this association can break, causing a real and unmodified result to be consumed in an incompatible execution context and lead the agent to an unsafe action. We characterize this failure as tool-result misbinding. To systematically study this failure, we introduce ReplayBench, a benchmark that uses controlled tool-result replay to evaluate misbinding across 19 representative agent scenarios, 4 failure properties, and 3 replay mechanisms. Across eight LLMs, three agent frameworks, and diverse stateful workflows, we find widespread replay-induced failures, with a mean Final-State Error Rate of 0.649 under cross-task replay. translated_title: TRAP：用于探测LLM智能体中工具结果错误绑定的重放攻击
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体越来越多地通过外部工具执行操作，工具结果不再是简单的输出，而是必须与产生它们的上下文保持正确关联的执行产物。然而，当这些结果在缓存、恢复机制和共享运行时状态中持久存在时，这种关联可能会被破坏，导致一个真实的、未经修改的结果在不兼容的执行上下文中被使用，从而使智能体采取不安全的行动。我们将这种失效定义为工具结果错误绑定。为了系统地研究这一失效，我们引入了ReplayBench，这是一个利用受控工具结果重放来评估错误绑定的基准测试，涵盖19个代表性智能体场景、4种失效属性和3种重放机制。在八个LLM、三个智能体框架以及多样化的有状态工作流中，我们发现了普遍存在的重放诱导失效，在跨任务重放下平均最终状态错误率达到0.649。分阶段分析定位了这些失效……
tldr: 该论文提出TRAP工具结果重放攻击和ReplayBench基准，系统揭示了LLM智能体在缓存和状态持久化中存在的工具结果错误绑定漏洞，跨任务重放可导致高达0.649的平均最终状态错误率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRAP, a tool-result replay attack, and ReplayBench, a benchmark that systematically probes tool-result misbinding in LLM agents, revealing widespread replay-induced failures with a mean Final-State Error Rate of 0.649 under cross-task replay.
